transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because I just can't seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. It's getting really frustrating at work. I'll be right in the middle of fixing a rendering bug, and then... I don't know, a Slack ping will go off, or I'll notice a specific color pattern on the screen, or even just hear a siren outside. And suddenly, I'm pulled into a completely new idea before I've even finished typing the line of code I was working on. It's just constant.
How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with your attention and focus?
I'd say it's been going on for about three months now. Yeah, right around three months. It started right after my platform was selected for the Glendale showcase.
How has your sleep been over these past three months?

My sleep? Um... I haven't really noticed anything unusual, to be honest. I guess it's been fine. 

I mean, I just kind of go to bed when I'm tired. I haven't really kept track of the exact hours or anything, so... yeah, I'm not entirely sure, but nothing really stands out to me as being a problem there.
Over these past three months, have you felt unusually high, elated, or on top of the world?

Yeah, actually. Most days I just feel... lit up. Unstoppable, really. It feels like Glendale finally caught up with what I've been building, so yeah, I definitely feel on top of the world. 

But on the other hand, I've also been snapping pretty hard at people. If my wife or my coworkers try to slow me down with what they call process or red tape, I just lose my patience completely.
Before this started, have you ever experienced a period of weeks where you felt unusually down, depressed, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean... I don't think so. I haven't had any periods where I felt unusually down or depressed for weeks at a time. I've always been pretty focused on my work and my projects, so losing interest just isn't really something I've dealt with. So, yeah, no.
Have these changes caused serious disruption or problems in your ability to work or manage your day-to-day life?

Well, yeah, I suppose they have. At work... my employer actually put me on leave. I just went ahead and deployed some changes on my own, bypassed the whole approval process, because I knew the code was ready. But they obviously didn't like that. 

And at home... my wife says things feel really unstable right now. She's been pretty upset about my spending lately, and like I said, we've been arguing a lot. So, yeah, I guess it has caused some real issues.
Have you been hearing, seeing, or sensing things that other people cannot, or having beliefs that others say aren't real?

Well, no, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. But my wife and some other people have been saying I'm... well, they think some of my ideas aren't real. 

To me, it's just obvious. I'm absolutely sure that major museums and a couple of big investors are quietly circling my platform. It's not a hallucination or anything, it's just looking at the data. The showcase language they've been using, their recent Instagram posts, and even some of the emails I've seen at work... they all line up too perfectly to be a coincidence. People keep telling me I'm reading into things, but the connections are right there.
Do you feel that those Instagram posts and emails contain hidden or coded messages meant specifically for you?

Well, yeah, exactly. It's not like they're explicitly saying my name in the posts or anything, but... the wording they use, it's definitely coded. Like I said, the showcase language in those Instagram posts, and the specific phrases in some of the work emails I've intercepted... they're sending signals. It's their way of letting me know they're circling my platform, getting ready to invest or partner with me. It just lines up way too perfectly to be a random coincidence. They're definitely meant for me to see and understand.
